subject: toeic
source_type: 독창적 비공식 TOEIC 연습문제; 공식 기출 아님

manual_review.scope: 문법·어휘·문맥과 선택지 유일성을 검토. ETS 공식문제 복제 아님.

passage: Text messages: Nora: The inspection was set for Wednesday morning, but the inspector called. Evan: New time? Nora: Thursday at 2:30 P.M. Please keep the loading area clear from 2 to 4. Evan: I will notify the warehouse team.
prompt: When will the inspection take place?
explanation: Nora states the new inspection time is Thursday at 2:30 P.M.
quick_solution: 처음 일정과 변경된 새 일정 구분.

distractor_analysis.note: 2–4 P.M. is the time to keep the loading area clear, not inspection start.

hints: 문장 구조나 지문에서 시점·대상·요청 단서를 확인하세요.
